_comment: Output schema for parser.py / parse_jd(). Fields added to job dict under job['parsed']. Source: PARSER_PROMPT in prompts/parser-prompt.md. v1.1: must_have_skills is now technical-only; experience_requirements added for soft/experience/education reqs.
must_have_skills: ONLY specific technical skills, tools, frameworks, and platforms explicitly required (e.g. SQL, Python, dbt, AWS). No years of experience, degrees, or soft skills.
nice_to_have_skills: preferred/bonus technical skills and tools only
technical_stack: all specific technologies, tools, platforms mentioned anywhere in the JD
experience_requirements: years of experience, domain background, education/degree, soft skills, and competency requirements
responsibilities_summary: 2-3 sentence summary of what the role does
team_size_hints: any mentions of team size or reports, or null
salary_mentioned: any salary info found as string, or null
remote_restriction: geographic restriction for remote jobs (e.g. 'US only', 'North America', 'EMEA') or null if unrestricted/not applicable
red_flags: anything concerning: unrealistic requirements, too many hats, etc.
key_phrases: 3-5 distinctive phrases that capture what makes this role unique
